classification.question_topic: Asking for logical explanation of apparent shared Mall World dreaming / being recognized by another dreamer; asking if others have different appearance in Mall World

meta.occupation_in_dream: Has a job/role in Mall World (not specified).
meta.final_emotion: Unsettled / uncomfortable / surreal ("It was uncomfortable... Surreal... I'm unsettled")
meta.author_theory: Possibilities mentioned: author is crazy; the other person is crazy; the other person is psychic and messing with them; or a "cold reading prodigy".

interactions.description: In waking life, author talks with a friend-of-a-friend's daughter about "mall world dreams"; author describes who they are there and their job; the teenager recognizes the author from her dream point of view and teases the author for their appearance there (author is "much shorter" in Mall World). They both cry. The teenager tells the author's friends embarrassing stories of things the author has done in dreams, from her perspective. Teenager reports that the author (in Mall World) saved her from a tsunami. Teenager knew the author's Mall World nickname, which the author says they have never written down.

entities_involved.description: Friend of friends' daughter (teenager) who reports having Mall World dreams and recognizing the author there.
Friends present during the conversation; later told embarrassing dream stories by the teenager.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post is primarily about an alleged shared-dream recognition event in waking life; no concrete Mall World layout/locations are described. A tsunami is mentioned as an event within Mall World dreams, but without scene details. The author references having a particular job/role and nickname in Mall World and having a different appearance (shorter), but specifics of the job, setting, and sequence inside the dream are not provided.
